shortDescription: UPSSSC Excise Constable (Aabkari Sipahi) Eligibility Result 2026 out on 28 July 2026. 32,891 candidates shortlisted for Mains against 820 posts. Check at upsssc.gov.in.
content:
UPSSSC has released the Eligibility Result for UP Excise Constable (Aabkari Sipahi) recruitment under Advt. No. 08-Exam/2026.

Applications were accepted from 04 June 2026 to 24 June 2026 (correction till 01 July 2026). On 28 July 2026, the commission shortlisted 32,891 candidates for the Mains written examination against about 820 posts, based on PET-2025 scores.

Indicative PET shortlist cutoffs (as reported)

  • UR / OBC / EWS: around 69.13
  • SC: around 66.80 | ST: around 52.86
  • Women and other categories as per official notice

This is a shortlisting result for Mains—not the final selection. Verify exact cutoffs and your status only on upsssc.gov.in.
